links.outcome: Case diagnosis present in differential: LLMs vs traditional DDSS on same cases
links.effect: Without labs, DDSS 56% (20/36) vs LLM1 42% (15/36) and LLM2 39% (14/36), not significant (P=.09, P=.08). With labs, DDSS 72%, LLM1 64%, LLM2 58%.
links.quote: In the version with all findings but no laboratory test results, the DDSS listed the case diagnosis in its differential diagnosis more often (56% [20 of 36]) than LLM1 (42% [15 of 36]) and LLM2 (39% [14 of 36]), although this difference did not reach statistical significance (DDSS vs LLMI, P = .09; DDSS vs LLM2, P = .08).

unlisted_practices: Hybrid approach combining LLM language parsing with deterministic expert diagnostic systems

screen.reason: Evaluates and compares the diagnostic accuracy of LLMs and an established expert diagnostic decision support system on unpublished retrospective clinical cases.
